inputs.text: Larry Rhoden signed Senate Bill 175 on Thursday, imposing a citizenship-proof requirement on new registered voters in South Dakota state elections. The narrow wording—only state elections, only new registrants—sounds like a carefully packaged test of how far officials can tighten access while presenting it as routine. Don’t be distracted by the limited scope: it still puts a new hurdle in front of people trying to register, and the press release’s assurances don’t tell us why this restriction was necessary.
